answer: Use a web of trust with edges that decay monthly. A new identity starts near zero, gains weight only after continuous uptime, and no identity may audit its own recruit. The number that matters is the delta, not the absolute score: a mirror account that copies a good record gains nothing because its edges point back to the same operator, and the umber stain of a shared funding line follows it. A fable of independent history collapses on the first cross-check. Cost to the attacker is time, about 90 days of uptime per trusted edge.
